1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] [Fan of Knives] - Increased the weapon damage of Fan of Knives from 130% to 150% while wielding daggers.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [I'm a Fan of Knives] - Increased the proc chance of I’m a Fan of Knives from 20% to 25%.

[Pending Restart] [Elune] [System Shock] - System Shock now also makes monsters take 50% increased damage from the caster while active. (This is a 2-second debuff that can trigger once every 8 seconds.)
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Poison Rain] - Now increases the damage of your Instant and Deadly Poison by 5% per stack. Buffed from 4%.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Shadow Artillery] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Shadow Artillery by 20%.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Impending Mortality] - Impending Mortality can now be triggered through Shattering Slam once every 20 seconds, buffed from once every 30 seconds.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Fury of the Eagle] - You can use Fury of the Eagle while Swashbuckling or having a Single Two-Handed Weapon equipped.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Talonshrike] - Talonshrike now increases the damage of Raptor Strike, Counterattack, and Mongoose Bite by 30%, buffed from 25%.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Talonshrike] - You can now benefit from Talonshrike while Swashbuckling or having a Single Two-Handed Weapon equipped.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Odyn's Fury] - Odyn's Fury now causes your next 3 Bloodthirst, Mortal Strikes, or Whirlwinds to deal 50% increased damage, buffed from your next 2.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Crimson Defense] - Blocking an attack while Champion’s Courage is active has a 33% chance to lower the cooldown of Avenger’s Shield by 5 seconds.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Frontliner damage reduction has been increased from 5% to 8%.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Clad in Frost] - Clad in Frost has been changed from reducing physical damage by 5% to reducing all damage taken by 5% while Ice Barrier is active.

[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Blurred Blade] - Blurred Blade has been changed from reducing magic damage taken by 8% to reducing all damage taken by 8%.
